primary.title: BEML shares to be in focus on Monday after securing additional $5.35 million Middle East export order
primary.summary: BEML Ltd. secured a $5.35 million export order, raising its contract total to $41.73 million. The company's international order book reached $112.35 million. Despite record revenue, net profit declined. Shares have fluctuated since 2024, currently down 36% from a peak.
